react_result.final_narrative_text: Multi-paradigm pathway enrichment converges on a single biological module: arachidonic acid metabolism. Three orthogonal methods independently ranked this pathway first or among the top hits with high statistical significance. RaMP multi-DB ORA returned 14 SMPDB drug-action pathways (all NSAID-class) as top-ranked (FDR = 9.17e-18, 6/6 input metabolites mapping), reflecting that every input compound except CDP is a known molecular target of cyclooxygenase and lipoxygenase inhibitors. MetaboAnalystR KEGG-specific ORA identified KEGG:hsa00590 (arachidonic acid metabolism / prostaglandin-leukotriene synthesis) as rank 1 with p = 7.54e-08, with five of the seven metabolites (arachidonic acid, leukotriene A4, 11,12,15-THETA, 15-HETE, 5-HETE) as direct pathway members. Mummichog m/z-direct analysis independently assigned arachidonic acid metabolism as rank 1 (p = 5.04e-04) and leukotriene metabolism as rank 4 (p = 0.031), with full 13-compound overlap on the 13-member MFN arachidonic-acid set. All six driver lipids are C20 polyunsaturated fatty-acid derivatives sharing arachidonic acid as their upstream substrate; five are direct products or downstream products of the 5-lipoxygenase and cytochrome-P450 branches. CDP (C00112) contributed only to the Mummichog glycerophospholipid and N-Glycan pathways with weaker p-values and does not participate in the arachidonic acid eicosanoid cluster. The treatment condition is most consistent with disrupted eicosanoid synthesis — likely a COX/LOX inhibition scenario — where upstream arachidonic acid accumulates while downstream cyclopentenone prostaglandins (15d-PGJ2) and lipoxygenase products (5-HETE, 15-HETE, LTA4) remain differentially abundant, suggesting either substrate accumulation or flux redistribution through alternative branches of the pathway.

  "narrative_text": "Three orthogonal pathway-analysis methods independently converged on arachidonic acid metabolism as the dominant affected pathway. RaMP multi-database ORA returned SMPDB:SMP00353 (Leukotriene C4 Synthesis Deficiency) as rank 0 with FDR = 9.17e-18 and fold enrichment of 857.8, with 6 of the 7 input metabolites (all except CDP) annotated to that pathway. CDP is a confirmed outlier: it does not map to the top-ranked eicosanoid pathways and contributes only to lower-ranked Mummichog outputs.
